description: This is a Java test class for the conditional headers validator in the 'things' persistence module, focusing on ensuring correct behavior of header validation logic related to entity tags and command categories.

classes.name: ThingsConditionalHeadersValidatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ConditionalHeadersValidator implementation used to validate conditional headers in 'things' operations.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the provider class is immutable.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfAllChecksSucceed
methods.description: Verifies no exceptions are thrown when headers and entity tags satisfy validation conditions.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfCheckIsSkippedBecauseOfNullAndQuery
methods.description: Ensures no exception is thrown when the command category is QUERY, skipping header validation.

methods.name: doesNotThrowExceptionsIfCheckIsSkippedBecauseOfNullAndDelete
methods.description: Ensures no exception is thrown when the command category is DELETE, skipping header validation.

methods.name: doesNotSkipIfEntityTagIsNullAndCategoryIsModify
methods.description: Ensures validation proceeds even if EntityTag is null for MODIFY commands.

methods.name: throwsThingPreconditionFailedExceptionWhenIfMatchFails
methods.description: Validates that a ThingPreconditionFailedException is thrown when the 'if-match' header validation fails.

methods.name: throwsThingPreconditionFailedExceptionWhenIfNoneMatchFailsAndCategoryIsNotQuery
methods.description: Validates that a ThingPreconditionFailedException is thrown when 'if-none-match' fails for categories other than QUERY.

methods.name: throwsThingPreconditionNotModifiedExceptionWhenIfNoneMatchFailsAndCategoryIsQuery
methods.description: Validates that a ThingPreconditionNotModifiedException is thrown when 'if-none-match' fails and the command category is QUERY.

methods.name: createRetrieveThingCommand
methods.description: Helper method to create a RetrieveThing command with specific headers and selected fields.

methods.name: createCommandMock
methods.description: Creates a mock Command object with specified headers and category for testing purposes.

methods.name: assertSkipForCommandCategory
methods.description: Asserts that validation is skipped for given command categories.

methods.name: assertETagHeaderInDre
methods.description: Asserts that the exception contains the expected entity tag in its headers.

methods.name: assertPreconditionFailed
methods.description: Checks that a precondition failure exception is correctly thrown with expected message and headers.

methods.name: assertNotModified
methods.description: Checks that a not-modified exception is correctly thrown with expected message and headers.
